verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's own docs say it standardizes the tool-calling interface across models and providers. Its API reference adds that it normalizes the request schema across providers, so a developer learns one schema for function calls on any supported model. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the tool-call schema and how it handles provider-specific differences, evidence of streamed tool-call deltas, independent hands-on corroboration of tool calling specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: OpenRouter standardizes the tool calling interface across models and providers, making it easy to integrate external tools with any supported model.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
Building agents with tool use, loops, and state
